Company Name: Lakeside Garden Gallery
Location: Brampton, ON, CA

Source: indeed
Job Description: Lakeside Garden Gallery is a thriving organization. We have a brand new building to serve our community better. Established in 1984 in Brampton, Lakeside provides superior Garden Centre and Landscape services to our valued customers. We are providing career opportunities to grow with us.

Applications are currently being accepted for:

**Experienced Florist Designer**

The Floral Designer is responsible for providing a high standard of customer service, designing custom pieces, merchandising and displays, as well as maintenance of stock/inventory levels in the store.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Consistently create floral designs incorporating effective and innovative use of colors, floral materials, vessels and accent materials.
* Create and maintain seasonal planters using available supplies for everyday sales.
* Be aware and be responsible for planning for upcoming holidays.
* Meet and consistently maintain required standards of production.
* Check on shipment \& delivery status. Receive merchandise. Maintain proper inventory levels.
* Keep accurate and updated files.
* Assist store and delivery associates with questions and concerns.
* Interact with customers and provide suggestions and recommendations for diverse needs.
* Successfully interpret clients' wishes on custom design orders and following up to ensure complete satisfaction.
* Actively work with management and marketing to promote and build floral department sales.
* Actively work with management and marketing to maintain and monitor promotional items.
* Work with marketing to keep floral pages on website current.
* Maintain a safe and clean work environment at all times.

**WAGE RANGE:** $21 to $25 an hour

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

· Two plus years of hands\-on custom floral design experience in a floral shop or design studio.

· Ability to efficiently and professionally meet client needs. Any combination of education, training, or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

· Works well in a team environment.

· Flexible schedule and availability on weekends and public holidays as needed.

· Demonstrates proficiency with Windows operating system and Microsoft Office and POS.

· Physical ability to stand for extended periods; bend, stoop and kneel frequently.

· Lift; carry and load 30 pounds (minimum) weight requirements.

· Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing with co\-workers and customers.

· Strong organizational, multi\-tasking, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.

*See the full job postings at www.lakesidegardengallery.com*

*Lakeside Garden Gallery is an equal opportunity employer. Under AODA, if you require interview accommodations, please include this in your cover letter.* 

Please submit your resume to employment@lakesidegardengallery.com..
